verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs explicitly describe a Scheduled Flags feature that lets you queue changes to feature flags and have them automatically applied at a specified future time, removing the need for manual intervention at that moment — directly matching the story. This is further complemented by Release Pipelines, which can automatically stage/progress rollouts with triggers, reinforcing scheduled/automated release workflows. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the scheduling UI/behavior beyond first-party docs.
